purpose: Reconstructed historical studies. New drawings, not original archival sketches.

attempts.prompt: Create a unified pencil character-development sketch strip for an Airtap brand presentation, landscape very wide 3:1 composition. EXACTLY FIVE complete hand mascots in one evenly spaced horizontal row, centers at 10%,30%,50%,70%,90% canvas width, equal scale and baseline, generous blank margins. Use attached five reference images in order ONLY for shape and face design: 1 broad U smile and dot eyes from the front view of reference1; 2 smaller U smile and small oval eyes from front of reference2; 3 open outlined happy mouth and vertical eyes from upper-left of reference3; 4 short U smile with long vertical pill eyes from upper-left of reference4; 5 short U smile with round eyes from upper-left of reference5. Each mascot has EXACTLY THREE upright finger lobes (middle tallest) and ONE side thumb pointing to VIEWER RIGHT, compact rounded palm, no wrist, no limbs. Preserve subtle original body proportion differences but use identical viewing angle and overall height. These are historical smiling face studies: NO nose. Professional industrial designer hand sketches, thin confident graphite strokes, visible delicate pencil construction contours, sparse fine hatch shading under fingers and along palm, slight cream pencil wash. Off-white paper background #FAF9F6, clean untextured near-white edges; no gray rectangles, no 3D rendering, no glossy material, no heavy scribble. Single coherent drawing style for every study. No text, no letters, no numbers, no arrows, no watermarks, no labels, no borders, no additional faces or details floating around.

Create ONE landscape 3:2 pencil sketch study sheet containing exactly SIX rear-view Airtap hand mascots in a strict 3 column x 2 row grid, generously separated, equal size/camera/baselines. Reference1 is STYLE ONLY: match its thin confident graphite outlines, sparse delicate hatch shading, subtle cream wash, warm white #FAF9F6 paper. References2-5 show seams, a tag, a recessed star and a raised star: use ONLY their BACK views (rightmost hands). The A and crease variants are described below. In reading order: upper-left two glove seams descending from finger valleys; upper-center recessed capital A in lower back; upper-right tiny pink woven tab on lower right edge; lower-left three shallow curved knuckle creases; lower-center recessed pink FOUR-point organic star with three subtle knuckle creases; lower-right raised pink FOUR-point organic star with three subtle knuckle creases. All backs have EXACTLY three upright round finger lobes (middle tallest) and ONE side thumb on VIEWER LEFT, compact rounded palm, NO face, no nose, no mouth, no arms, legs or wrist. Use same hand silhouette as sources, don't add fingers. Distinguish recessed vs raised star with pencil shading and inset versus cast shadow. Historical pink stars remain pink. Fine industrial-design pencil drawing, same quality and lineweight as style reference. No 3D render, no photography, no gray boxes. No labels, no text except the embedded A design itself, no numbering, no arrows, no borders, no watermarks, no extra details.

Redraw the attached five-character study strip as extremely simple clean outline drawings on a TRANSPARENT background. Preserve exactly five complete hand mascots in the same left-to-right order, same faces and silhouette, same size and one-row composition. Delicate consistent dark muted graphite-gray lines, about 2px, minimal confident slightly hand-drawn contours. Outline only: NO hatching, NO construction lines, NO shading, NO shadows, NO ground line, NO paper texture, NO cream wash, NO gradients, NO realistic volume. The only solid dark areas are the small eyes and mouth strokes; keep the third open mouth hollow, outlined. Body interiors transparent. Exactly 3 upright finger lobes and 1 side thumb on VIEWER RIGHT each. No nose, no additional facial changes, no labels or typography. Wide 3:1 canvas with ample transparent gaps around and between the five characters. This will be placed on a warm white slide #FAF9F6; transparent interiors and exterior must seamlessly reveal that background.

Redraw reference1 six rear-view Airtap mascots as very simple clean contour line drawings on TRANSPARENT background. Match reference2 minimal line style. Keep exactly SIX complete hand backs in a 3 columns x2 rows grid, equal scale, same body silhouette (three upright finger lobes, middle tallest, ONE thumb on viewer LEFT, no wrist/limbs/faces). Fine consistent dark gray contour lines. NO hatching, NO shading, NO shadow, NO ground lines, NO construction lines, NO paper, NO gradients, NO realistic volume. Empty body interiors and outside entirely transparent. Correct the lower row: remove the two vertical seam lines currently erroneously repeated on all lower hands. Instead lower row hands EACH have exactly three small shallow HORIZONTAL curved arcs, one across the base of each upright finger, like original reference3 knuckle creases. Grid reading order: 1 two vertical glove seams; 2 small outlined capital A embedded lower back; 3 small pink outline woven tab at lower right edge; 4 ONLY the three horizontal knuckle arcs, otherwise blank back; 5 those three arcs plus small pink four-point star RECESSED (two close inset contour lines, no shadow); 6 those three arcs plus small pink four-point star RAISED (simple single outline with slight offset lower edge line, no shadow). Stars and tab only thin muted rose line accents, no fills. No labels or text except embedded A. No borders, no arrows, no watermark. Landscape3:2.
